text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Transcend—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, my. This eye-catching arcade 
cabinet, if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Transcend 
pointed, there was a claw machine filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Paka Puchi. Even though they're 
tiny, the chibi design is really well 
done.
choice_data_list:
...If you're curious, want to play with 
it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Me? Hmm, I mean, I am good at this 
stuff, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainy, you give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. Watching Trai-chan fret from 
the side while I make a big fuss, that's 
the drill!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, how are your gaming skills? 
Good? Average? ...Or maybe, super 
terrible?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And next~ maybe win a mountain of Paka 
Pouch plushies? ...You'd be lying if you 
said this didn't give you chills!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: And with that, let's get to it~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
